title: SkyraIngestionBatchResponseV1
description: Authoritative atomic batch acceptance response for Skyra LogHub Ingestion Gateway v1.

status.description: Durable acceptance status. Emitted only after fsync to crash-recoverable journal log.

batch_id.description: Canonical batch UUID (either client-supplied or gateway-assigned for legacy envelope).

accepted_count.description: Total number of events durably accepted in this atomic batch.

duplicate.description: Indicates whether this response is an idempotent confirmation of a previously committed batch.

receipt_id.description: Unique durable receipt identifier for tracking and reconciliation.

journal_segment.description: Identifier of the active journal WAL segment containing this batch.

journal_offset.description: Byte offset of the committed batch record within the journal segment.

committed_at.description: Server commit timestamp in RFC3339 UTC format ending with Z.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 payload digest verified by the gateway against batch content.
